observations: RECONCILE HEP - CHI cham toi observed_behavior/risk/unknown_areas/profile_conflicts lien quan nguong resize mockup (KB-083). TOAN BO phan con lai cua profile (capabilities, confirmed_rules, state_transitions khac, permissions, surface_mapping, dependencies, cac risk khac, coverage_matrix, cac unknown_areas khac) GIU NGUYEN KHONG DOI theo dung pham vi duoc giao.

Evidence moi (run CTX-20260914-01): upload RIENG LE (cach nhau >1 phut, khong dong thoi, loai tru hoan toan bien concurrency da phat hien o run truoc) cho anh 999x999px (layer 4508) va 1001x1001px (layer 4509) - CA HAI deu KHONG bi resize, xac nhan qua 2 nguon doc lap (API /api/mockup-layers sau xu ly xong VA doc pixel that qua CDN+sips, ngoai UI/API cua app).

KET QUA NAY LECH voi cau tra loi MOI cua PO (2026-09-14: nguong = 1000px). Theo yeu cau cua tac vu: KHONG duoc viet 'nguong resize = 1000px' nhu confirmed rule. Conflict CONF-CHK-06-005-001 GIU NGUYEN trang thai UNRESOLVED - chi CAP NHAT ca 2 phia voi evidence moi nhat, KHONG tu chon phia.

Nang confidence cho BAN THAN hanh vi 'khong resize trong khoang 900-1001px' tu LOW len HIGH (nhat quan qua 5 diem du lieu: 900/960/999px tu run truoc + 999/1001px rieng le run nay, xac nhan qua 2 layer doc lap). Cau hoi 'nguong THAT SU la bao nhieu (neu co)' VAN o dang OBSERVED_CURRENT/UNRESOLVED - can test voi anh > 1001px (vd 1500/2000/3000px) de tim nguong thuc su, ngoai pham vi duoc giao cho run nay.

feature_profiles.name: Upload va Gan Mockup cho Product Base
feature_profiles.user_goal: La owner, upload anh mockup moi hoac chon tu media library, va gan cho product base/variant de preview san pham.

actors.permission_observed: Upload va gan mockup, upload file sai dinh dang/qua kho, Save that modal Assign mockups, thao tac Edit/Duplicate/More tren mockup card thanh cong tren product base 3203/3243, khong gap access-denied.

entry_points.precondition: dang o trang edit cua product base

capabilities.name: Upload mockup moi
capabilities.description: Luong 4 buoc tach roi: (1) POST /api/users/{userId}/temporary-files/upload-url; (2) PUT thang len CDN (khong qua backend teeinblue); (3) POST /api/mockup-layers/by-temporary-file; (4) POST /api/products/{id}/mockups. Khong gioi han kich thuoc file o buoc (1) - da xac nhan voi file 15MB van tra 201.

capabilities.name: Media library modal
capabilities.description: Chon anh co san; category qua GET /api/mockup-layer-categories, danh sach anh qua GET /api/mockup-layers (phan trang offset).

capabilities.name: Trang thai Rendering + Refresh icon (khong co polling tu dong)
capabilities.description: Card mockup hien 'Rendering' sau khi gan. KHONG co request polling tu dong nao (0 entries trong 8.2s cho khong tuong tac). Bam icon Refresh ('.la-sync') kich hoat 1 lan goi lai GraphQL 'mockups' that, UI chuyen tu 'Rendering' sang hien anh that ngay sau do.

capabilities.name: Modal 'Assign mockups' - Save that
capabilities.description: 2 cot 'Select variants'/'Select mockups' kem Select all moi cot. Bam Select all + chon mockup + Save THAT chay mutation GraphQL that update_mockups_many(_set:{variant_ids:[...]}), affected_rows=1. Gan thanh cong CHO DU product KHONG bat toggle 'Custom variant's printarea' - xac nhan gan mockup cho variant hoan toan doc lap voi Custom Printareas.

capabilities.name: Card mockup: Edit / Duplicate / More (khong co nut 'Move' rieng)
capabilities.description: 3 icon nut that (Edit, Duplicate, More '...') cong 1 drag-handle de keo-tha doi vi tri - KHONG co nut 'Move' rieng biet (khac voi gia dinh cu cua v1). Edit mo 'Mockup Editor' full-screen canvas that. Duplicate goi mutation that, tao 1 ban ghi mockup MOI (id moi), copy nguyen variant_ids tu ban goc. More mo dropdown 4 tuy chon: 'Add to campaigns', 'Sync to campaigns', 'Remove from all campaigns', 'Delete mockup' - chi 'Sync to campaigns' da duoc bam thu (xem capability rieng).

capabilities.name: 'Sync to campaigns' tren mockup card bi chan o client (chua ket luan bug/by-design)
capabilities.description: Tren product DANG lien ket that voi 1 campaign (need_sync=true), bam 'Sync to campaigns' tren 1 mockup card hien dialog CHAN ngay: 'Mockup is not used in any campaign.' (chi co Cancel) - KHONG co request nao duoc gui, need_sync khong doi. Toan bo quyet dinh chan la o phia CLIENT.

observed_behavior.statement: Buoc PUT upload binary di thang len oe-cdn.sgp1.digitaloceanspaces.com bang presigned URL, KHONG qua backend teeinblue.

{userId} trong path buoc 1 (POST /api/users/{userId}/temporary-files/upload-url) = users.id (266), KHONG phai staffs.id (sub=273) - route DUY NHAT trong toan bo capture co id nguoi dung nam trong path.
Media library dung phan trang offset (?page&per_page), khac cursor pagination cua /products chinh.

[CHK-06-004] Upload file .txt doi ten .png lam mockup: KHONG bi chan o client (khong kiem tra magic-byte); duoc dua vao hang doi va hien 'Rendering' MAI MAI; backend da nhan va tao ban ghi (width=0, height=0, cac URL rong) nhung render that bai KHONG bao loi ro rang cho user - khoang trong UX. PO chi de nghi 'explore, tu tao data test' (khong assert ket qua), nen giu OBSERVED_CURRENT.

[CHK-06-005, cap nhat 2026-09-14] Chon 5 file cung luc (900/960/999/1000/1200px) o run truoc: CHI 3/5 file dau (900/960/999) thuc su duoc xu ly (goi y gioi han CONCURRENCY ~3 khi chon nhieu file cung luc, 2 file con lai bi bo qua AM THAM khong loi/canh bao); ca 3 file GIU NGUYEN kich thuoc goc. RUN NAY (CTX-20260914-01) test LAI RIENG LE (cach nhau >1 phut, loai tru hoan toan bien concurrency): anh 999x999px (layer 4508) VA 1001x1001px (layer 4509) DEU KHONG bi resize - xac nhan qua 2 nguon doc lap (field width/height cua GET /api/mockup-layers SAU KHI xu ly xong han, VA doc pixel THAT qua tai truc tiep file _large.webp tren CDN + lenh `sips`, ngoai UI/API cua app). Ca 999px VA 1001px deu KHONG resize - LOAI TRU truc tiep gia thuyet nguong=960 (tu truoc) VA LECH voi cau tra loi MOI cua PO (1000px, 2026-09-14). NGUONG THAT SU (neu co) VAN CHUA duoc xac dinh - can test voi anh > 1001px (vd 1500/2000/3000px). Xem conflict CONF-CHK-06-005-001 (VAN UNRESOLVED) - KHONG duoc khang dinh nguong cu the nao, ke ca '1000px' cua PO.

[CHK-06-010] Mockup card co 3 action that (Edit/Duplicate/More) + 1 drag-handle re-order, KHONG CO nut 'Move' rieng biet (sua lai gia dinh cu cua v1 tung dat cau hoi ve 'Move' nhu mot action doc lap). Duplicate tao ban ghi moi that, copy variant_ids tu ban goc. More mo dropdown 4 tuy chon, 3/4 (Add to campaigns/Remove from all campaigns/Delete mockup) CHUA duoc bam thu.

[CHK-06-010, MISMATCH-003] 'Sync to campaigns' tren 1 mockup bi CHAN o CLIENT voi dialog 'Mockup is not used in any campaign.' du product DANG lien ket that voi 1 campaign (need_sync=true) - khong co request nao duoc gui. CHUA KET LUAN day la bug hay by-design; co the mockup thieu lien ket campaign_mockups rieng, khac voi lien ket product<->campaign da xac nhan (CHK-08-008).

risks.risk: TTL, scope (bucket/prefix) cua presigned upload URL chua quan sat duoc vi response bi redact hoan toan theo redaction policy - rieng gioi han kich thuoc file da duoc xac nhan la KHONG CO (KB-082).
userId trong path buoc 1 dung users.id thay vi staffs.id (route duy nhat khac biet nay) - rui ro nham lan dinh danh neu co logic phan quyen dua tren path param o tang khac.

[SEC-004] Upload mockup khong kiem tra magic-byte; file sai dinh dang duoc backend nhan, tao ban ghi (width=0,height=0) va KET O TRANG THAI 'RENDERING' VINH VIEN khong bao loi ro rang cho user - nguoi dung co the cho vo ich khong biet upload that bai.

[CONF-CHK-06-005-001, cap nhat 2026-09-14] Nguong resize thuc su van CHUA duoc xac dinh dut diem. Evidence run CTX-20260913-02 (900/960/999px) VA run CTX-20260914-01 (999px, 1001px rieng le, loai tru bien concurrency) DEU cho ket qua KHONG resize - truc tiep LECH voi cau tra loi MOI cua PO (1000px). Day KHONG con la 'thieu du lieu don thuan' ma la 2 lan kiem chung doc lap CUNG phan bac con so PO dua ra; van GIU UNRESOLVED, KHONG tu chon phia. Rui ro: neu QA/dev mac dinh dung '1000px' lam nguong that de viet test oracle se SAI voi hanh vi da quan sat 2 lan. Can test voi anh > 1001px de tim nguong thuc su (neu co).

[MISMATCH-003, chua ket luan] 'Sync to campaigns' bi chan o client du product da lien ket campaign that - neu day la bug, user se khong dong bo duoc mockup vao campaign khi can; neu la by-design, thieu thong bao ro rang giai thich dieu kien 'used in campaign'.
